boundary: Fresh native process to first verified count received by parent. OS file cache is not flushed. Compile and JSONL generation excluded. Workload N unique asserted triples, p->q produces 2N results. Delta is max(1,N/100) new facts committed without re-saving the prepared cache. Before/after order alternates by sample.
p95_method: nearest rank; five samples is not a reliable tail-latency estimate
